Treatment summary
Patient presented following a rear-end collision sustained while the patient was
turning left, with neck pain and restricted cervical range of motion consistent with a
whiplash-type mechanism. The reported injury corresponds well with the kind and force
of the impact described. Over the course of care, the patient completed 28 visits
including manual therapy, supervised therapeutic exercise, and home exercise
instruction. Imaging and examination findings clearly confirm soft tissue injury to
the cervical spine. No prior injury to the same body region is known from the history
obtained. Treatment followed a typical clinical progression, with visit frequency
tapering as symptoms improved and range of motion returned toward functional limits.
Two similar billing entries for the same date of service are currently under review and
are being verified against the clinic's records. Patient was discharged to
self-directed home exercise with instructions to return if symptoms recur.
